subject: how to remove extra base line in ggplot2-density plots

messages.author: e07a0ed181cfd28d
messages.subject: how to remove extra base line in ggplot2-density plots
parts:
Hi

When ever I draw a density plot using geom_density it is creating a
extra line at the bottom. Does any one know how to ignore this and
plot just like normal plot in R ? If I use geom_freqpoly this line
will be gone. Can i remove this line in geom_density as well ?

For ex: Look at pictures here
http://learnr.wordpress.com/2009/03/16/ggplot2-plotting-two-or-more-overlapping-density-plots-on-the-same-graph/

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: how to remove extra base line in ggplot2-density plots
parts:
I don't believe there's a way to do that, since they're drawn using polygons... One possible workaround is to add a geom_hline at y=0 something like this:
... + geom_hline(yintercept=0, colour="white", size=1)

-Winston

messages.subject: Re: how to remove extra base line in ggplot2-density plots
parts:
Hi,

You can use geom_line(..., stat="density") instead of geom_density(...)

HTH,

b.
